mathematical_contract.wrapper_invariant: PairOverlapMap is created only after exact supporting-circle coincidence and positive-length overlap have been certified. Mapping changes the owning cusp semicircle and parameter orientation while preserving the represented geometric point.
mathematical_contract.carrier_recovery: The implementation recursively peels only PairOverlapMap wrappers and stops at an exact Rational map/contact record. Parallel, Pair, and PairOverlap evidence is never treated as rational-source evidence.
mathematical_contract.correspondence: The recovered source and rational target enter the single RationalBezierOverlapParameterCorrespondence2 authority. That authority independently certifies a common rational image, isolates a unique target preimage, replays exact incidence, and validates the destination overlap range before publication.
mathematical_contract.policy: The recovered source policy must equal the active CurveContext policy. STRICT accepts only exact evidence. APPROXIMATE_512 follows the same proof graph and may terminate only at the common 512-bit predicate boundary.
mathematical_contract.failure: Missing rational lineage, policy mismatch, absent shared-image proof, non-unique preimage, failed incidence, or unresolved range remains explicit. No sampling, f64 conversion, tolerance, uncorrelated resultant-root matching, or finite projection is used.

capability.comparison_revision: A non-rational cut wrapped by PairOverlapMap had no represented rational value and therefore remained Unsupported when offered to a nonlinear rational target, even when the wrapper's source was an exact rational carrier.

capability.new_work_per_expanded_fixture: Across the two policies, the source fixture adds two exact reversed pair-overlap constructions and two exact nonlinear parameter transports while retaining all comparison-revision work.
